inputAndAssociation.saveInputs: Frontend sends body and explicit confidential only. Native DTO does not expose approved; do not infer approval or require plaintext response equality. Body is encrypted and metadata selects exclude ciphertext and plaintext.
inputAndAssociation.createMeeting: Truthy explicit clientId is a manual association; omitted clientId runs backend inference. The receipt may legitimately name an inferred client even when the form was unscoped.
inputAndAssociation.updateMeeting: Native checks property presence. Omitted clientId preserves association. Explicit clientId:null calls reassignMeetingClient with null, clears sharing when changed, and propagates null/current sharing state to denormalized children transactionally.

additionalReadLimit.classification: Existing native read-contract limitation; outside this bounded correction
additionalReadLimit.reason: listMeetingDebriefs serializes body/status and other metadata but omits sharedAt/sharedByUserId. Mutation/decorated meeting metadata includes them. Therefore a direct GET /debriefs fixture must not invent sharing stamps or qualify complete shared/unshare tab behavior from that list. No inferred sharing UI, guessed endpoint or backend write is introduced by this review.
additionalReadLimit.currentUiEffect: Before the caption correction, omitted sharedAt fell through to Private, including after an accepted native share. Independent caption red controls reproduce this on 01cba25; missing is not equivalent to explicit null.
additionalReadLimit.requiredProjection: Show Sharing status unavailable when sharedAt is undefined, preserve Private for explicit null and Shared with client team for a timestamp. Do not invent a field or enable Unshare without sharing knowledge.

authorityLimit: Backend authorization remains authoritative. Schema checks bind contextual receipts and reject malformed/inconsistent outcomes; they do not prove native execution, authorization, encrypted content equality or provider durability. Synthetic local browser requests are intercepted and no native effects are performed.
